English: Scroll Room
A humble tent or wooden lean-to, set aside for the storage of scrolls and basic records. Early efforts at administration and order in a newly settled domain.
Record Room
A sturdy, locked chamber within the keep, containing organized shelves and chests for records, census rolls, and ledgers. Enables more efficient administration and levying.
Manuscript Alcove
A partitioned area within a wooden outbuilding, reinforced with shelving for manuscripts and basic ledgers. Slightly improves record-keeping and local order.
Archive Chamber
A stone-vaulted chamber with iron doors, providing secure and fireproof storage for archives and legal documents. Strengthens governance and taxation.
Scholars Study
Dedicated stone rooms with writing desks and ample storage for reference works, supporting a small retinue of scribes and scholars. Greatly improves administrative efficiency and realm learning.
Book Repository
A fortified multi-room vault, filled with books, treatises, and codices. Guards are posted to protect the valuable knowledge, which now directly benefits administration, military, and learning.
Community Archive
An imposing archive complex, providing secure storage, scriptoria, and reading rooms for trusted officials and scribes. The center of administration and learning for the entire domain.
Council Library
A grand stone edifice with multiple levels, housing the records and treatises of generations. The seat of council deliberations, supporting advanced administration and military planning.
Elders' Archive
An ancient and storied archive, where the wisdom and records of countless rulers are preserved. The very heart of feudal governance and knowledge, empowering both rule and defense.
Grand Archive
A legendary center of learning and record-keeping, inspiring both loyalty and awe. All aspects of administration, defense, and knowledge are enhanced, securing your dynastys legacy for centuries.
